name: Delete Fallback Origin for Custom Hostnames
description: Delete Fallback Origin for Custom Hostnames Removes the fallback origin configuration for custom hostnames on a zone. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/fallback_origin
context:
DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/fallback_origin
Removes the fallback origin configuration for custom hostnames on a zone. Custom hostnames without specific origins will no longer have a fallback.
Required: zone_id (path)

name: Get Fallback Origin for Custom Hostnames
description: Get Fallback Origin for Custom Hostnames Retrieves the current fallback origin configuration for custom hostnames on a zone. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/fallback_origin
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/fallback_origin
Retrieves the current fallback origin configuration for custom hostnames on a zone. The fallback origin handles traffic when specific custom hostname origins are unavailable.
Required: zone_id (path)

name: Update Fallback Origin for Custom Hostnames
description: Update Fallback Origin for Custom Hostnames Updates the fallback origin configuration for custom hostnames on a zone. PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/fallback_origin
context:
PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/fallback_origin
Updates the fallback origin configuration for custom hostnames on a zone. Sets the default origin server for custom hostname traffic.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Create Custom Hostname
description: Create Custom Hostname Add a new custom hostname and request that an SSL certificate be issued for it. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames
Add a new custom hostname and request that an SSL certificate be issued for it. One of three validation methods—http, txt, email—should be used, with 'http' recommended if the CNAME is already in place (or will be soon). Specifying 'email' will send an email to the WHOIS contacts on file for the base domain plus hostmaster, postmaster, webmaster, admin, administrator. If http is used and the domain is not already pointing to the Managed CNAME host, the PATCH method must be used once it is (to complete validation). Enable bundling of certificates using the custom_cert_bundle field. The bundling process requires the following condition One certificate in the bundle must use an RSA, and the other must use an ECDSA.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Custom Hostname Details
description: Custom Hostname Details Retrieves detailed information about a specific custom hostname, including SSL certificate status, ownership verification, and origin configuration. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/{custom_hostname_id}

DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/{custom_hostname_id}/certificate_pack/{certificate_pack_id}/certificates/{certificate_id}

description: Delete Custom Hostname (and any issued SSL certificates) Permanently deletes a custom hostname and revokes any SSL certificates that were issued for it. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/{custom_hostname_id}

name: Edit Custom Hostname

name: Get Custom Hostname Quota
description: Get Custom Hostname Quota Returns custom hostname quota usage for a zone. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/quota
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/quota
Returns custom hostname quota usage for a zone. The allocated quota is a soft limit; creating custom hostnames after usage exceeds this limit can still succeed until the hard cap is reached. Use the exceeded and hard_cap fields to track when usage is above the soft limit and when new custom hostname creation will be rejected.
Required: zone_id (path)

name: List Custom Hostnames
description: List Custom Hostnames List, search, sort, and filter all of your custom hostnames. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames
List, search, sort, and filter all of your custom hostnames.
Required: zone_id (path)
Optional: hostname (query); hostname.exact (query); hostname.startsWith (query); hostname.contain (query); id (query); page (query); per_page (query); order (query); direction (query); ssl_status (query); hostname_status (query); certificate_authority (query); wildcard (query); custom_origin_server (query); ssl (query)
